allow: PowerShell($s = Get-Content .claude\\settings.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "settings.json parses OK"; foreach \($ev in @\("PreCompact","PostCompact"\)\) { $cmd = $s.hooks.$ev[0].hooks[0].command; if \($cmd -match "SESSION_HANDOVER"\) { "$ev references SESSION_HANDOVER.md" }; $json = $cmd -replace "^echo '","" -replace "'$",""; try { $null = $json | ConvertFrom-Json; "$ev payload is valid JSON" } catch { "$ev payload INVALID: $_" } })
